mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id, r.apply_message, r.create_time, m.member_id AS from_member_id, m.nickname AS from_nickname, m.avatar AS from_avatar FROM t_friend_request r INNER JOIN t_wx_member m ON m.member_id = r.from_member_id WHERE r.to_member_id = #{memberId} AND r.status = #{status} AND r.deleted_flag = #{deletedFlag} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
